style.backgroundSystem: deep roasted brown #3A2418 for opening and closing heroes, warm cream #F7ECD7 for infographic and scene shots, alternating for rhythm
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons and simple rounded label tiles in a single accent color
style.lightingSystem: soft warm top light with gentle falloff, 4200-5500K by scene, soft contact shadows, appetizing matte food texture, never plastic-looking
style.lockText: consistent warm rustic natural-food snack visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep roasted brown #3A2418, warm cream #F7ECD7, dark cocoa text #3B2A1A and one golden amber accent #D9A441; warm tone throughout; soft directional top light with gentle falloff and soft contact shadows; appetizing natural matte food texture, never plastic-looking; modern clean sans-serif headlines; consistent rounded label tiles and thin-line icons; natural woven-wood and cream paper surface language; product always grounded with a soft contact shadow; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no plastic-looking sheen on the food
style.presentationRules: product always grounded with a soft contact shadow, stable warm-toned scale, heaped or cracked-open presentation to show the kernel
style.surfaceSystem: natural woven bamboo, matte dark wood planks and warm cream paper board
style.typography: modern clean sans-serif headlines, no brush calligraphy
